title: Contractor / sub-contractor payments
applicability: Payments to resident contractors, sub-contractors and suppliers for works
conditions: Excludes cases covered by specific annexure entries; check annexure mapping
notes: Verify against the current FY SRO/Annexure before publishing. Do not guess.

title: Professional / advisory service fees
applicability: Payments for professional, advisory, technical or specialist services
notes: Service list varies by annexure entry — map each service explicitly.

title: Rental income
applicability: Deduction from rental income / house property payments
conditions: Landlord/tenant and commercial/residential variations may apply
notes: Verify current rate and any exemption thresholds.

title: Contractor - manufacturing / construction works
applicability: Manufacturing, process, conversion, construction or similar works

title: Deduction on specified services
applicability: Local VAT deduction on services specified by NBR for VDS
conditions: Service-specific rates; some services are excluded
notes: One row per service category — never a single blanket rate.

title: Standard VAT rate
applicability: Standard rate on taxable supplies and imports

title: Turnover tax (enlisted)
applicability: Enlisted suppliers below the VAT registration threshold
conditions: Input tax credit not available under this regime
notes: Verify turnover bands and rate for the current FY.

title: Reduced / truncated rate schedule
applicability: Sector-specific reduced rates (e.g. 5%, 7.5%, 10%) for specified goods and services
conditions: Populate rate_table JSON with sector, rate, conditions per entry
notes: Use rate_type=table and fill the rate_table JSON column.

title: Individual income tax slabs
conditions: Populate tax_slabs table; include surcharge and rebate rules separately
notes: Slabs belong in the tax_slabs table, not here.

title: Minimum tax rule
applicability: Floor tax payable irrespective of profit
conditions: Depends on location and business type

title: Private limited company (not listed)
applicability: Standard corporate rate for unlisted private companies
conditions: Rate may increase if banking-channel/TIN/return conditions are unmet
notes: Model conditional rate increases in the conditions JSON.

title: Bank / insurance / financial institution
applicability: Banking, insurance and NBFIs (listed vs not listed may differ)

title: Advance income tax on import
conditions: Rates vary by category and importer type
